title: Sausage & Peppers on Buns
seoTitle: Sausage & Peppers on Buns | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Italian sausage and peppers on hoagie rolls for the crew
subtitle: Italian sausage and peppers on hoagie rolls for the crew
description: Italian sausage links are roasted with bell peppers and onions, split onto hoagie buns, and finished with optional melted provolone. The tray should show sausage, coloured peppers, and long buns — distinct from sausage-peppers-onions skillet dinner.

steps.title: Prep sausage and vegetables
steps.instruction: Slice peppers and onions. Toss with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper on rimmed sheet pans. Nestle whole sausage links among vegetables.

steps.title: Roast until browned
steps.instruction: Roast at 425°F, turning sausage once, until sausages hit 160°F and peppers are tender with browned edges, 28–32 minutes. Cut sausages on a bias into chunks. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Toast hoagie buns
steps.instruction: Split buns and toast cut sides on a sheet pan at 425°F for 4–5 minutes until lightly crisp. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Assemble sandwiches
steps.instruction: Pile sausage and peppers into each bun. Add provolone if using and melt under broiler 2 minutes. Splash vinegar over the pan for brightness.

steps.title: Hold and serve
steps.instruction: Wrap sandwiches in foil and hold at 200°F up to 25 minutes. Leave one sandwich open on the tray for identification — sausage, peppers, and hoagie bun clearly visible.

proTips: Sweet and hot sausage mix adds variety without two recipes.
A foil-lined pan saves cleanup when sausage fat renders.
Mustard and hot peppers at the line turn this into a full sub shop spread.
tonightSpread: Sausage and pepper hoagies with chips
whyCrewsLikeIt: Hoagie feed is fast to eat and scales to fourteen easily. Skillet sausage and peppers already exist in the catalog as a plated dinner; this is the sandwich version crews grab with one hand.
mealPrepNotes: Poke sausages before roasting so they do not burst. Hoagies can be split and toasted 5 minutes in the oven. Hold sausage and pepper mix in a hotel pan at 165°F; assemble buns to order if calls interrupt.
